newsitem.title: ITALY: SOCCER-KANU READY TO PLAY AFTER HEART OPERATION.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-KANU READY TO PLAY AFTER HEART OPERATION.

text.p: Internazionale's Nigerian striker Nwankwo Kanu returned to Italy on Thursday and said he was ready to play again after undergoing a heart operation.
"Today I won't have any medical visits. I feel good and I'm sure of playing for Inter," Kanu said on arrival at Milan airport.
The African footballer of the year was signed by Inter from Ajax Amsterdam a year ago but has yet to play in serie A after pre-season medicals in 1996 revealed he had congenital heart disease.
Doctors warned at the time he could die if he carried on playing without an operation.
Kanu underwent surgery in Ohio last November and two months ago doctors said he could return to professional soccer.
Inter have said Kanu will undergo tests by club doctors to see if his health meets strict league medical regulations.
